meta.name: infographic-creator
meta.description: Create beautiful infographics based on the given text content. Use this when users request creating infographics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将文字内容转化为精美信息图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把文字数据做成视觉化图表
copy.tagline_en: Turn text content into beautiful infographics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn text data into visual charts

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你提供的文字内容，自动生成信息图（infographic）的 HTML 文件。它会先理解你的需求，选择合适的模板，然后用 AntV Infographic 语法描述图表结构，最后生成可下载为 SVG 的网页。
howto.when: 当你要求创建信息图（如“做个信息图”或“把这段内容做成图表”）时触发。

say.text: 把下面这段产品介绍做成信息图。
say.note: Claude 会解析文字并生成对应的信息图 HTML。

say.text: 用时间线模板展示互联网技术发展历程。
对比两个方案的优缺点，用左右对比图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate an infographic HTML file based on your text content. It understands your needs, selects a template, describes the chart using AntV Infographic syntax, and produces a downloadable SVG page.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create an infographic, e.g., 'make an infographic' or 'turn this content into a chart'.

say_en.text: Turn this product description into an infographic.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the text and generate the infographic HTML.

say_en.text: Show the evolution of internet tech with a timeline.
say_en.note: Claude will use a sequence-timeline-* template.

say_en.text: Compare pros and cons of two options side by side.
say_en.note: Claude will use a compare-binary-* template.
